MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth
WHERE (p.draft_pick IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62)
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR (p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
WITH p, birth,
     CAST(date_part('year', DATE '2026-10-15') - date_part('year', birth) -
       CASE WHEN date_part('month', DATE '2026-10-15') < date_part('month', birth)
                  OR (date_part('month', DATE '2026-10-15') = date_part('month', birth)
                      AND date_part('day', DATE '2026-10-15') < date_part('day', birth))
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS age
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WHERE (p.draft_pick IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62)
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR (p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
WITH p,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE
    WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS age
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(right(p.birth_date, 4) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'January' THEN 1
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'February' THEN 2
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'March' THEN 3
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'April' THEN 4
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'May' THEN 5
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'June' THEN 6
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'July' THEN 7
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'August' THEN 8
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'September' THEN 9
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'October' THEN 10
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'November' THEN 11
    WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'December' THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WHERE (p.draft_pick IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62)
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR (p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
WITH p, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
